top_offers.title: Staff Engineer
top_offers.why: Akuity was founded by the creators of Argo CD and builds a Kubernetes/GitOps platform for DevOps and Platform Engineering teams, which lines up well with the AWS/Docker/Kubernetes side of the profile. It's a genuine Staff-level IC seat at a product-focused infra startup, though the EMEA/APAC-with-US-overlap remote setup is a step down from Geneva or Europe-only remote.

top_offers.title: Senior Platform Engineer
top_offers.why: Direct platform-engineering ownership, building an Internal Developer Platform treated as a product, which matches the founding-engineer instinct for owning infrastructure end to end. The Senior (not Staff+) title and unspecified remote geography keep it a notch below the top tier.

top_offers.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) — Hosting Platforms
top_offers.why: Geneva-based and at a well-regarded independent Swiss cloud/hosting company, which scores well on location and culture. The title reads as an IC infrastructure role without an explicit senior/staff qualifier, so the scope looks narrower than the target seniority band.
